# bv install-skill — generates the new HEAD-based stop hook
$ bv install-skill claude --enable-hook
Installed /butverify skills for claude.
  ~/.claude/skills/butverify/SKILL.md            (installed)
  ~/.claude/skills/butverify/prove-it/SKILL.md   (installed)
  ~/.claude/skills/butverify/review/SKILL.md     (installed)
  ~/.claude/skills/launch-monitored-loop/SKILL.md (installed)
  Hooks: installed (~/.claude/settings.json)

$ cat ~/.claude/hooks/bv-stop-hook.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# [generated by bv agent-init]
marker="$HOME/.claude/bv-session-proven"
if [ -f "$marker" ]; then
  proven_ref=$(cat "$marker" 2>/dev/null)
  current_ref=$(git rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$current_ref" ]; then
    if [ "$proven_ref" = "$current_ref" ]; then
      rm -f "$marker"
      exit 0                         # ← proves against HEAD
    fi
  else
    if [ -n "$proven_ref" ]; then
      rm -f "$marker"
      exit 0                         # ← non-git: any non-empty marker
    fi
  fi
fi
printf '[butverify] Run /butverify:prove-it before stopping.\n' >&2
exit 2                               # ← blocks until proven

# --- Hook behavior demo ---

# [1] No marker → blocks
$ bash ~/.claude/hooks/bv-stop-hook.sh
[butverify] Run /butverify:prove-it before stopping.
exit code: 2 ✓

# [2] Marker = current HEAD → allows silently
$ echo "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" > ~/.claude/bv-session-proven
$ bash ~/.claude/hooks/bv-stop-hook.sh
exit code: 0 ✓  (no output — silent clean exit)
$ ls ~/.claude/bv-session-proven
ls: no such file  (marker deleted — one-time use)

# [3] Marker = OLD head (new commit after proving) → blocks again
$ echo 'aaaaaaaabbbbbbbbccccccccddddddddeeeeeeee' > ~/.claude/bv-session-proven
$ bash ~/.claude/hooks/bv-stop-hook.sh   # current HEAD is af1a7f07...
[butverify] Run /butverify:prove-it before stopping.
exit code: 2 ✓  (stale marker rejected)

# --- Tests ---
$ go test ./cmd/bv/... -run TestStopHookScript_Shape -v
=== RUN   TestStopHookScript_Shape
--- PASS: TestStopHookScript_Shape (0.00s)
